bio.jane/contract.question: What somatic-mutation calls does this array result carry?

description: Read an Affymetrix array result's own somatic-mutation calls: one row per mutation probe set with the producer's call, the score behind it and the two thresholds that call was graded against. OncoScan CNV Plus states this table; CytoScan and SNP 6.0 results do not, and the tool says so rather than answering empty.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

detected_only.description: report only the calls the producer detected. Default false: the undetected rows are what say the probe set was READ and came back wild type, which is a different answer from the probe set being absent.

file.description: which copy-number file in this project, by name. Unset, it is the project's only one — and it refuses rather than guessing when there are several.

name: copy_number_somatic

calls.description: one entry per mutation probe set: probe_set (the producer's own identifier), call (its word — `Detected`, `Undetected`, or a third this reader passes through unchanged), detected (that word tested against the undetected one), score (MutScore, the statistic the call was made on), signal (QNSignal, the quantile-normalized signal behind the score), threshold_high and threshold_low (MutThreshHigh/MutThreshLow — the bars THIS probe set was graded at, which differ row to row), and from the array's annotation database for the genome the file states: gene, mutation (protein and cDNA change), cosmic (COSMIC id), chromosome, and position (1-based, the variant's first base); all five are null for a probe set that database does not list or when the file states no genome it is cached for.

detected.description: the subset of `calls` whose word is not the undetected one — the mutations this sample actually carries, in the same shape

provenance.description: which file answered, the container kind it was read from, the name of the data set the somatic table was found in, how many rows it holds, placement (which annotation database, genome and retrieval date placed the calls and how many it placed, or why none were placed), and the vocabulary note: the call words are the producer's own and are not normalized here

summary.description: how many mutation probe sets this file states, how many the producer detected, and which array wrote them
